therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: selective killing of hairy cell leukemia cells expressing CD25

results.effect_size: 6/15 patients achieved response (1 complete remission, 5 partial responses)
biomarker_changes: ≥50% decrease in hairy cell count by flow cytometry in responders
results.dose_information: 40 micro-g/Kg infused over 30 minutes every other day for 3 doses, up to six treatment cycles every 4 weeks

context.duration: 6 months primary assessment, median response duration 23.5 months (95% CI: 5.1-45.1)
